Name: FS-The Veil Hairstyle
Author: Lazinis
Description:
（顶部注释）注意：这些发型不适合重新着色——重新着色后效果会很糟糕。
我或许有一天会尝试制作可重新着色的版本，但不能保证。所有这些发型都是我在自己的游戏中不断调整和修改，
直到感觉完美为止。它们仅供我个人使用。我灵感一来就会画，即使我完全不知道自己画的是什么乱七八糟的东西。
我的英语……嗯，相当糟糕。哦，对了，我的农民角色使用的是桃子体型。
我没有在其他体型上测试过这些发型（懒得试）。文件名中的“Chris”是我原创角色全名的缩写。
【发型更新：当星辰连成一线时】为了方便起见，我会先积累一些新发型再考虑发布。
这只是分享——我不会参与任何讨论。如果你有任何发型创意，欢迎标记我！ （我的所有发型都是免费/公开的。
【关于旧版本】先说明一下：我之前的mod是我第一次上传的作品。
描述是由AI（豆包）翻译的，说实话，现在用我现在的眼光来看，设计显得笨拙且业余。
所以，我对其进行了彻底的修改和更新。---英文描述由DeepSeek翻译。如果您发现任何不通顺的措辞，请责怪翻译者，而不是作者的英语！（开玩笑啦。）



(Note at the Top)Heads up: These hairstyles are NOT recolor-friendly—they'll turn out looking bad. I might take on the challenge of making recolorable versions someday, but no promises.All these hairstyles are born from me tweaking and adjusting non-stop in my own game until they feel just right. They're made for my personal use. I draw whenever inspiration hits, even when I have no idea what messy stuff I'm scribbling. My English is, well, pretty rough. Oh, and my farmer uses the Peach body type. I haven't tested these hairstyles on other body shapes (couldn't be bothered).The "Chris" in the filename is a shortened version of my OC's full name.【Hairstyle Updates: When the Stars Align】To keep things simple, I'll accumulate a bunch of new hairstyles before considering a release. This is just for sharing—I won't be joining any discussions.If you have a hairstyle idea, feel free to tag me! (All my hairstyles are free/public.【Regarding the Old Version】Just putting this out there: my previous mod was my first-ever upload. The description was translated by an AI (Doubao), and honestly, looking at it now with my current eyes, the design feels clunky and amateurish. So, I've given it a complete overhaul and refresh.---English description translated by DeepSeek.If you spot any awkward phrasing, blame the translator, not the author's English! (Just kidding.)
